top_strength: Joanna gathered logistics details systematically (stairs, floor numbers, item list, box count, walking distance) and delivered a clear, all-inclusive pricing explanation with the No Worries damage coverage and on-time guarantee embedded in the rate.
coaching_note: The two-concerns question was skipped entirely — Joanna asked open-ended instead of the primary v4 opener, and when the customer said 'just price,' she moved straight to probing without the step 3 promises framing that directly addresses reliability and damage concerns; also, the ask came without rate lock/no deposit language first, and was too soft when the customer requested an email quote.
